entries.name: Normally open contact
entries.summary: A contact shown open in the normal state defined for its device.

entries.name: Normally closed contact
entries.summary: A contact shown closed in the normal state defined for its device.

entries.name: Changeover contact
entries.summary: A contact arrangement switching a common connection between two contact paths.

entries.name: Relay coil
entries.summary: The operating element associated with a relay and its separately drawn contacts.

entries.name: Contactor
entries.summary: An electrically operated switching device commonly used for repeated switching duties.

entries.name: Normally open pushbutton
entries.summary: A pushbutton contact normally shown open before actuation.

entries.name: Normally closed pushbutton
entries.summary: A pushbutton contact normally shown closed before actuation.

entries.name: Emergency-stop operator
entries.summary: An identified emergency-stop operator and its documented contact arrangement.

entries.name: Selector switch
entries.summary: An operator switch selecting between documented control positions.

entries.name: Indicator lamp
entries.summary: A visual indicator associated with a documented control or equipment condition.

entries.name: PLC input / output
entries.summary: A controller interface point connecting field signals to an identified module channel.

entries.name: Resistor
entries.summary: A resistive component with its value and purpose documented separately.

entries.name: Mechanically latched relay coil
entries.summary: A mechanically latched relay retains a documented state after the initiating electrical command is removed.

entries.name: Relay reset coil
entries.summary: A reset coil releases or changes the retained state of its associated latching relay.

entries.name: Solid-state relay
entries.summary: A solid-state relay switches an output through semiconductor circuitry in response to a control input.

entries.name: Polarised relay coil
entries.summary: A polarised relay has operation or a specified response that depends on the documented electrical polarity.

entries.name: AC relay coil
entries.summary: An AC relay coil is intended for a specified alternating-current control supply.

entries.name: High-speed relay
entries.summary: A high-speed relay has a documented operating response intended for duties where relay timing matters.

entries.name: Measuring relay
entries.summary: A measuring relay responds to a measured electrical quantity and issues an output according to its configuration.

entries.name: Relay coil with diode suppression
entries.summary: A relay with diode suppression includes a diode associated with its coil to limit the transient on de-energisation.

entries.name: Relay coil with diode and LED
entries.summary: A relay assembly with diode and LED combines coil transient suppression and a visible energisation indicator.

entries.name: Relay coil with capacitor suppression
entries.summary: A relay with a capacitor suppression element includes a documented capacitive network associated with the coil.

entries.name: Relay coil with RC suppression
entries.summary: A relay RC suppression network uses resistance and capacitance associated with the coil circuit.

entries.name: Counter relay with manual reset
entries.summary: A manually reset counter relay records qualifying events and retains a count until the documented reset action.

entries.name: Counter relay with electrical reset
entries.summary: An electrically reset counter relay has a separate reset command or documented electronic reset mechanism.

entries.name: Non-resettable counter relay
entries.summary: A non-resettable counter records events without a normal user reset function.

entries.name: On-delay timer relay
entries.summary: An on-delay timer postpones a specified output transition after its timing condition becomes active.

entries.name: Off-delay timer relay
entries.summary: An off-delay timer holds a specified output condition for a documented period after its initiating condition is removed.

entries.name: On-delay normally-open contact
entries.summary: An on-delay NO contact changes from its unoperated open state only after the associated timing condition has persisted for the documented delay.

entries.name: On-delay normally-closed contact
entries.summary: An on-delay NC contact opens after the associated timing condition has persisted for its documented interval.

entries.name: Off-delay normally-open contact
entries.summary: An off-delay NO contact retains the documented operated state for an interval after the timer trigger is removed.

entries.name: Off-delay normally-closed contact
entries.summary: An off-delay NC contact returns to its documented normally-closed state after the delay following removal of the timing trigger.

entries.name: Maintained normally-open contact
entries.summary: A maintained NO contact retains the actuated closed position according to its mechanism or control arrangement.

entries.name: Maintained normally-closed contact
entries.summary: A maintained NC contact retains its actuated position until the documented return action occurs.

entries.name: Manually unlatched NO contact
entries.summary: A manually unlatched NO contact includes a mechanical retaining action released by a documented manual operation.

entries.name: Manually unlatched NC contact
entries.summary: A manually unlatched NC contact has a mechanical retained state and a documented manual release.

entries.name: Early-make normally-open contact
entries.summary: An early-make NO contact closes earlier in the mechanism sequence than specified associated contacts.

entries.name: Late-make normally-open contact
entries.summary: A late-make NO contact closes later in a documented mechanism sequence than associated contacts.

entries.name: Early-break normally-closed contact
entries.summary: An early-break NC contact opens earlier in a documented mechanical sequence than associated contacts.

entries.name: Late-break normally-closed contact
entries.summary: A late-break NC contact opens later in the documented operating sequence than specified associated contacts.

entries.name: Make-before-break changeover contact
entries.summary: A make-before-break changeover contact establishes the next path before releasing the previous path during its documented transfer.

entries.name: Motor overload trip NC contact
entries.summary: An overload trip NC contact opens on the documented overload relay operation.

entries.name: Motor overload alarm NO contact
entries.summary: An overload alarm NO contact closes on the documented overload relay operation.

entries.name: Illuminated normally-open pushbutton
entries.summary: An illuminated NO pushbutton combines a manual normally-open contact function with an indication lamp.

entries.name: Illuminated normally-closed pushbutton
entries.summary: An illuminated NC pushbutton combines a normally-closed manual contact with a lamp in the operator assembly.

entries.name: Maintained normally-open pushbutton
entries.summary: A maintained NO pushbutton stays in its actuated condition until the documented return operation.

entries.name: Maintained normally-closed pushbutton
entries.summary: A maintained NC pushbutton retains its actuated open state until the documented return action.

entries.name: Key-operated normally-open switch
entries.summary: A key-operated NO switch closes a contact through an authorised key mechanism.

entries.name: Key-operated normally-closed switch
entries.summary: A key-operated NC switch opens its reference closed contact through the key mechanism.

entries.name: Latched key-operated switch
entries.summary: A latched key-operated switch retains its commanded position according to the selected mechanism.

entries.name: Pull-cord switch
entries.summary: A pull-cord switch converts a cord-operated mechanical action into an electrical contact change.

entries.name: Foot-operated switch
entries.summary: A foot-operated switch uses a pedal mechanism to change an electrical contact.

entries.name: Lever-operated switch
entries.summary: A lever-operated switch changes contact state through a manually operated lever.

entries.name: Three-position maintained selector
entries.summary: A three-position maintained selector stays at the selected position until manually moved.

entries.name: Three-position selector returning from left
entries.summary: This three-position selector has a documented spring return from its left position.

entries.name: Three-position selector returning from right
entries.summary: This three-position selector returns from its right position according to its mechanism.

entries.name: Three-position centre-return selector
entries.summary: A centre-return selector returns from both outer positions to its documented central rest position.

entries.name: Three-position key selector
entries.summary: A three-position key selector combines position selection with a key-operated mechanism.

entries.name: Four-position maintained selector
entries.summary: A four-position maintained selector provides four stable operating choices.

entries.name: Four-position key selector
entries.summary: A four-position key selector provides key-controlled selection among four documented positions.

entries.name: Normally-open limit switch
entries.summary: A normally-open limit switch closes when the documented mechanical travel or position condition actuates it.

entries.name: Normally-closed limit switch
entries.summary: A normally-closed limit switch opens when the documented mechanical position actuates it.

entries.name: Roller-operated limit switch
entries.summary: A roller-operated limit switch transfers equipment motion through a roller actuator to its electrical contacts.

entries.name: Cam-operated limit switch
entries.summary: A cam-operated limit switch changes its electrical contact state when a defined cam profile reaches the actuator.

entries.name: Pressure switch NO
entries.summary: A pressure-operated NO switch closes when its documented pressure condition actuates the mechanism.

entries.name: Pressure switch NC
entries.summary: A pressure-operated NC switch opens under its documented actuation condition.

entries.name: Temperature switch NO
entries.summary: A temperature-operated NO switch changes from open to closed under its specified actuation condition.

entries.name: Temperature switch NC
entries.summary: A temperature-operated NC switch opens under a documented thermal condition.

entries.name: Self-operating thermal switch
entries.summary: A self-operating thermal switch responds directly to its thermal condition rather than through a separate powered relay input.

entries.name: Float level switch NO
entries.summary: A float-operated NO level switch changes contact state through a float mechanism at a documented fluid level.

entries.name: Float level switch NC
entries.summary: A float-operated NC level switch opens when its documented level condition actuates the mechanism.

entries.name: Liquid flow switch
entries.summary: A liquid-flow switch issues a contact state when a documented flow condition actuates it.

entries.name: Gas flow switch
entries.summary: A gas-flow switch changes contact state for a specified gas-flow condition.

entries.name: Inductive proximity switch
entries.summary: An inductive proximity switch detects a documented target without a mechanical contact actuator.

entries.name: Three-wire inductive proximity switch
entries.summary: A three-wire inductive proximity switch uses separate supply, common and output conductors.

entries.name: Capacitive proximity switch
entries.summary: A capacitive proximity switch detects a target through a change in its sensing capacitance.

entries.name: Magnetic proximity switch
entries.summary: A magnetic proximity switch detects a documented magnetic target or field condition.

entries.name: Photoelectric emitter-receiver switch
entries.summary: A photoelectric emitter-receiver device uses an optical path to determine a switching output.

entries.name: Variable resistor
entries.summary: A variable resistor provides a documented adjustable resistance in a circuit path.

entries.name: Potentiometer
entries.summary: A potentiometer uses a movable contact on a resistive element to provide a documented adjustable divider or resistance.

entries.name: Light-dependent resistor
entries.summary: A light-dependent resistor changes resistance according to illumination.

entries.name: Heating element
entries.summary: A heating element converts electrical energy to heat in a documented circuit.

entries.name: RC network
entries.summary: An RC network combines resistance and capacitance in a specified circuit arrangement.

entries.name: Varistor
entries.summary: A varistor is a voltage-dependent resistive component used in a documented circuit, often for transient limiting.

entries.name: Current-measuring shunt
entries.summary: A current-measuring shunt produces a documented voltage drop corresponding to current through a resistive element.

entries.name: Electrolytic capacitor
entries.summary: An electrolytic capacitor has a specified capacitance, voltage rating and any documented polarity requirement.

entries.name: Feedthrough capacitor
entries.summary: A feedthrough capacitor is arranged with a conductor path and a documented capacitive connection used in filtering.

entries.name: Adjustable capacitor
entries.summary: An adjustable capacitor provides a documented variable capacitance.

entries.name: Diode
entries.summary: A diode provides a semiconductor path with documented directional conduction characteristics.

entries.name: Photodiode
entries.summary: A photodiode is a light-sensitive semiconductor device used in a documented sensing circuit.

entries.name: Zener diode
entries.summary: A Zener diode is a semiconductor component intended for a documented reverse-breakdown operating function.

entries.name: DIAC
entries.summary: A DIAC is a bidirectional triggering semiconductor device used in a documented control circuit.

entries.name: Single-phase bridge rectifier
entries.summary: A single-phase bridge rectifier converts its specified AC input to a DC output through a bridge arrangement.

entries.name: Three-phase bridge rectifier
entries.summary: A three-phase bridge rectifier converts a documented three-phase AC input into a DC output.

entries.name: Silicon-controlled rectifier
entries.summary: An SCR is a thyristor with a gate-controlled triggering function in its documented circuit.

entries.name: Gate-turn-off thyristor
entries.summary: A gate-turn-off thyristor has a documented gate-controlled turn-off capability.

entries.name: TRIAC
entries.summary: A TRIAC is a bidirectional thyristor used for a documented AC switching or control function.

entries.name: Bidirectional breakdown diode
entries.summary: A bidirectional breakdown diode provides a documented voltage-limiting semiconductor path in both polarities.

entries.name: Transformer-fed indicator lamp
entries.summary: A transformer-fed indicator lamp includes a documented internal voltage-conversion arrangement.

entries.name: Push-to-test indicator lamp
entries.summary: A push-to-test indicator lamp allows a documented local test of the lamp circuit.

entries.name: LED indicator lamp
entries.summary: An LED indicator assembly provides a documented visual signal using a semiconductor light source.

entries.name: Flashing indicator lamp
entries.summary: A flashing indicator lamp provides a documented intermittent visual indication.

entries.name: Flashing beacon
entries.summary: A flashing beacon gives a documented conspicuous visual signal.

entries.name: Rotating beacon
entries.summary: A rotating beacon provides a documented rotating visual signal through its specified mechanism or assembly.

entries.name: PLC digital input
entries.summary: A PLC digital input reads a documented discrete electrical state from field wiring.

entries.name: PLC relay output
entries.summary: A PLC relay output switches a documented contact path through the module's relay interface.

entries.name: PLC transistor output
entries.summary: A PLC transistor output switches a documented electronic path for a field load.

entries.name: PLC analog input
entries.summary: A PLC analog input measures a documented voltage, current or sensor quantity.

entries.name: PLC analog output
entries.summary: A PLC analog output provides a documented variable voltage or current signal to another device.

entries.name: PLC temperature input
entries.summary: A PLC temperature input connects a documented RTD, thermocouple or compatible sensor through the selected module.

entries.name: Power contactor
entries.summary: A power contactor switches a power circuit through an electrically operated mechanism.

entries.name: Reversing contactor assembly
entries.summary: A reversing assembly uses coordinated switching devices to change a motor connection sequence.

entries.name: Star-delta starter assembly
entries.summary: A star-delta starter arranges switching devices to change a motor winding connection during starting.

entries.name: Thermal overload relay
entries.summary: A thermal overload relay monitors motor-circuit loading and operates associated control contacts.

entries.name: Electronic motor overload relay
aliases: Electronic motor overload relay general arrangement
Electronic motor overload relay panel layout
entries.summary: An electronic overload device provides the specified motor monitoring and trip functions.

entries.name: Soft starter
entries.summary: A soft starter controls motor starting through power-electronic switching.

entries.name: Variable-frequency drive
entries.summary: A variable-frequency drive supplies a controlled-frequency motor output.

entries.name: Drive braking resistor
entries.summary: A braking resistor dissipates energy when specified as part of a drive braking system.

DIN-rail AC/DC power supply panel layout
entries.summary: A DIN-rail power supply converts an input supply into a specified DC auxiliary supply.

entries.name: DIN-rail DC/DC converter
entries.summary: A DC/DC converter changes a DC supply to the specified output arrangement.

entries.name: DC redundancy module
entries.summary: A redundancy module combines specified supply paths for an auxiliary DC system.

entries.name: DC buffer module
entries.summary: A buffer module supports a DC bus through specified short supply interruptions.

entries.name: DC UPS module
entries.summary: A DC UPS module manages continuity of a DC auxiliary supply with its specified energy-storage interface.

entries.name: Battery charger
entries.summary: A battery charger maintains a specified battery supply or starting battery system.

entries.name: PLC CPU module
entries.summary: A PLC CPU executes the programmed control logic of an automation system.

entries.name: PLC power module
entries.summary: A PLC power module supplies the specified controller and expansion system.

entries.name: Digital input module
entries.summary: A digital input module brings discrete field states into a controller.

entries.name: Digital output module
entries.summary: A digital output module switches or signals discrete outputs under controller command.

entries.name: Analogue input module
entries.summary: An analogue input module receives the specified continuous measurement signals.

entries.name: Analogue output module
entries.summary: An analogue output module sends the specified continuous command signals.

entries.name: Remote I/O station
entries.summary: A remote I/O station places input and output interfaces away from a controller CPU.

entries.name: HMI touchscreen
entries.summary: An HMI presents operating information and control interfaces to the user.

entries.name: Industrial panel PC
entries.summary: An industrial panel computer provides a computing platform within an equipment arrangement.

entries.name: Industrial Ethernet switch
entries.summary: An industrial Ethernet switch interconnects devices in the specified communication network.

entries.name: Industrial VPN router
entries.summary: A remote-access router provides the specified network interface between control equipment and other networks.

entries.name: Communication gateway
entries.summary: A gateway connects the documented communication protocols or network boundaries.

entries.name: Interface relay module
entries.summary: An interface relay separates a controller signal from the specified switched circuit.

entries.name: Relay socket
entries.summary: A relay socket supports a plug-in relay and its associated connections.

entries.name: Timer relay
entries.summary: A timer relay changes its outputs according to the selected time function.

entries.name: Safety relay module
entries.summary: A safety relay performs specified monitored control functions within a documented safety circuit.

entries.name: Signal conditioner
entries.summary: A signal conditioner converts or isolates the specified instrumentation signal.

entries.name: Emergency stop station
entries.summary: An emergency stop station houses the specified emergency-control actuator and contacts.

entries.name: Pilot-light station
entries.summary: A pilot-light station displays the documented equipment states through its lamps.

entries.name: Selector-switch station
entries.summary: A selector station provides the selected maintained or returning control positions.

entries.name: Trapped-key interlock assembly
entries.summary: A trapped-key arrangement coordinates access or switching through the selected mechanical key sequence.

entries.name: Door-mounted pushbutton enclosure
entries.summary: A local control station houses the specified operator actuators and contacts.
